column3: Enough. Vale lost the\nStars, and now Vale would\nfight my battle for me?{end_wait}
Mia, Jenna and Kraden are\nhis hostages. Fight with\nus, not against us.{end_wait}
Excuses. You could not\nguard one sanctum, and\nyou ask me to trust you?{end_wait}
I'm asking you to move.\nI won't stand aside while\nJenna is up there.{end_wait}
Then prove you are worth\nstanding beside. Draw your\nblade, Isaac. Alone.{end_wait}
Settle it, then. I can\nwait. It shows me what\nyou are made of.{end_wait}
Tch... You are stronger\nthan a fool has any right\nto be.{end_wait}
That is enough. He held\nback. I could feel it in\nevery blow.{end_wait}
We aren't your enemy, Mia.\nWe want Jenna and the\nStars back, same as you.{end_wait}
...Then I will trust you.\nA little. Hold Saturos.\nI go after Menardi.{end_wait}
Keep him busy, fools. I\nwill bring the captives\nback myself.{end_wait}
The healer has gone ahead.\nNow, Adepts. It is your\nturn.{end_wait}
